name: Foreign Money In Missions
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign creation of the world and mankind's unique role as His image-bearers with dominion over the earth, underscoring the divine purpose behind human stewardship. The gospel commission given by Christ commands believers to make disciples of all nations and preach the gospel throughout the entire world, emphasizing the global scope of missions. While the sample verses do not directly address foreign money, they establish the biblical mandate for worldwide evangelism, which often involves cross-cultural support and resources to fulfill the Great Commission.
